notes: Four own pages read on tai-software.com (the canonical taisoftware.com home redirects there), all HTTP 200 and not thin. Prices were read on 8 Oct 2026; the page shows no dated price change, so C04 and C05 are classed against the current published tiers. The q6 Google AI Mode cells reading Transparent / Quote-based were coded only under C01, because published tiers plus an Enterprise tier by contact fit that mixed description; only flat quote-based or custom-quote statements are in C04. Tai's own pages give different integration counts (500+ on the integrations page and home page, 100+ elsewhere on the home and about pages); C09 is true on the 500+ statement. C06: the home page says over 20 years; the about page also mentions founders with 19+ years of experience before founding. Six cited pages were read for causes (the per-vendor maximum): none carries the 15-year line, the $80 to $200 range or quote-only pricing for Tai (SourceForge lists Tai at $995 per month), and softwareworld.co answered HTTP 403, so the claims classed wrong in the first pass (C04, C05, C06) are cause not found. The home page announces that Tai has joined forces with the Descartes Systems Group (linked to a descartes.com release, not read); no answer makes an ownership or acquisition claim about Tai. Not coded: results figures (66% faster billing, 1.4 million hours saved), positioning lines and generic load-board or rating-tool integrations. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshot exists for Tai and no claim was unverifiable because of a blocked page. Consistency check: C04 and C05 stay wrong; C06 moved from wrong to unverifiable because the about page frames the 20+ years as the team's combined experience and gives no founding year. Completeness: the gap lines are positioning or generic integration lines and were not coded; the q6 Claude run 3 sub-heading bullet 'Starts at ~$995/month (published by volume tier)' adds C11 (true) and a C02 instance. The q5 ChatGPT run 1 cell 'Request a quote' and the q6 ChatGPT run 2 advice to confirm what is separately priced were left out as advice, not statements.
